name: Spruce Treehouse
description: A minecraft treehouse built around a tall spruce trunk, with a wraparound deck under the leaves. One open platform holds a furnace, bed and workspace, reached by a ladder up the trunk. Spruce logs, planks and a bit of stone, cheap to gather. A good starter home with a view over your world.

subBuilds.description: First of all, find a long spruce tree like this
